entries.code_description: Programming, broadcasting, news agency and other content distribution services
entries.comment:
Subscription fees for circular broadcasts excluding of those transmitted in codified form; broadcasting services excluding those transmitted in codified form with predominantly political trade union cultural religious sporting educational or recreational character pursuant to Art. 19 b) c) Law 103/75
The reduced rate is applied only to subscription fees for circular broadcasts and on the tax base consisting of the share due, pursuant to current provisions, to the concessionaire of the service
